name: Naya Tactca Nanafe
original_name: ナーヤ＝トトカ・ナナフィ
source:
The President of "Magic World" and a member of "Tacta" family with cat-ears. While Naya is very young, she is a skilled engineer and possess great knowledge and maturity despite her looks. She can be clumsy at times, however. Naya gets along well with Ruputuna.

[spoiler]She's the reincarnation of the god Himeora.[/spoiler]
